title: Enya [V5]
description: Post Malone freestyle, recorded during sessions with Kanye in August 2015. Features Theophilus London and has Kanye vocals at the start. Post Malone does some of the lines that Kanye would later use on the song, and a mix of new finished vocals and mumble. Potentially intended to be cut-down into a verse the way his "Fade" freestyle was. Samples "Return To Innocence" by Enigma. Original snippet leaked August 15th, 2020, and a VC recorded snippet leaked November 6th, 2023.

title: "Logan's Run" Foam Hiker Boot
description:
Background: Designed by Nick Daiber & Strah, nicknamed after the sci/fi novel and film "Logan's Run," the foam hiker boot was initially one of many foam footwear concepts made by the Yeezy team in Wyoming. However, of all the concepts, apart from the foam runner, this boot saw the most development with "over 50" (per @archiving.ideas) colorways and multiple versions. The mold of the sole for the boot was even brought back for experimenting in Yeezy Season 9 footwear. 

On 8/14/2020, Ye would tweet a picture of this pair captioned "Logan's Run."

This specific colorway is the most known/seen, as it was used in multiple YZYGAP photoshoots and even worn by Ye in the Donda: With Child short film.
